title: Resolve frontend build/runtime deployment blockers and update publishing troubleshooting notes

requirements.summary: Make minimal frontend code/asset reference adjustments to ensure build + deploy succeeds and the deployed site renders without runtime blank screens.
acceptanceCriteria: Running `dfx generate backend` completes without errors.
Running `dfx deploy` completes without errors and publishes updated frontend + backend canisters.
The deployed site loads successfully in a browser with no blank screen caused by runtime errors.

file_operations.description: Replace the logo image reference that uses a spaced filename ("/assets/Logo design for Madh.png") with a stable generated asset path to prevent missing-static-asset deployment failures; use the existing generated logo at frontend/public/assets/generated/madhavi-logo-transparent.dim_200x200.png. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update header logo to reference the same stable generated logo asset (frontend/public/assets/generated/madhavi-logo-transparent.dim_200x200.png) to avoid runtime broken images and reduce risk of deploy-time missing asset errors. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update footer logo to reference the same stable generated logo asset (frontend/public/assets/generated/madhavi-logo-transparent.dim_200x200.png) to avoid missing static assets after deploy. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Validate that all default montage image paths correspond to assets that exist under frontend/public/assets/generated/ and adjust any paths that are inconsistent (e.g., prefer .jpg when a referenced .gif is not present) to avoid runtime warnings/errors that could contribute to a blank screen. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Harden montage initialization against missing/failed default assets so the section gracefully shows its existing error-state UI rather than risking unhandled runtime issues; keep behavior minimal and avoid new features. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Update frontend/PUBLISHING.md with concise, English-only deployment troubleshooting notes reflecting current build/deploy prerequisites and likely failure points.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/PUBLISHING.md` includes a concise troubleshooting section with at least: (1) how to identify missing static assets, (2) what to do if `dfx generate backend` outputs outdated bindings, and (3) what to check when `dfx deploy` fails.
All added documentation text is in English.

file_operations.description: Complete the currently truncated document and add an English-only 'Troubleshooting' section covering: (1) identifying missing static assets referenced by UI (especially frontend/public/assets/generated/* and any logo references), (2) steps to resolve mismatched/outdated generated bindings after `dfx generate backend` (including cleaning/re-running generation and rebuilding), and (3) checks to perform when `dfx deploy` fails (e.g., build output present, correct Node/pnpm/dfx versions, successful `pnpm build:skip-bindings`, and verifying no runtime errors after deploy).
